import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df=pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cols=['canopy_cover','soil_moisture','elevation_m','road_dist_km','leaf_litter','temperature_c','slope_deg','nitrate','grazing_index','rainfall_mm']
# marginal effects conditioned region; and full model
for x in cols:
 m=smf.ols(f'species_richness ~ {x} + C(region)',df).fit()
 print(x, round(m.params[x],3), round(m.pvalues[x],5), round(m.rsquared,3))
print('\ncorrelations')
print(df[cols+['species_richness']].corr().round(2).to_string())
